//: Copy to config.json and fill in. config.json is gitignored.
//avProduct: Display name reported for the AV product.
//avServiceNames: Windows service names that indicate the Bitdefender agent is running. First one found is used.
//watchServices: Critical services to watch. running/stopped is reported for each; stopped + critical is flagged.
//topProcessCount: How many top processes (by memory) to include as a light summary. 0 to disable.
